sources.snippet: Overview deepseek-vl-1.3b-base is a compact vision-language model developed by deepseek-ai that processes images and text together for multimodal understanding tasks. The model uses the SigLIP-L vision encoder supporting 384×384 pixel images and is built on DeepSeek-LLM-1.3b-base, which was trained on approximately 500 billion text tokens.
